name: spot-core
description: Spot metering at the AF target, exposure part, as the E-M5 II 4.1 does it: with metering Spot, Spot HI or Spot SH (prm 0x80A1 = 1, prm 0x9699 = 0/1/2) and that variant On (settings 593 / 660 / 621 = prm 0x94D1 / 0x9F91 / 0x9821, u8, 0 = Off), single-target AF (prm 0x84D1 = 0), no C-AF+TR (prm 0x6761 = 0) and the live-view sensor modes HS, HSSC (not its HS3D crop) or MSSC, the 4x4 spot window of the 18x18 BV grid moves to the selected AF target (prm 0x88B2, 0..34). Elsewhere, and with the tele-converter map B, it stays at the centre. Code in the exp debug printers (segment 1). See experiments/2026-11-24-af-spot-metering/NOTES.md.
_interface: settings 593 (prm 0x94D1), 660 (prm 0x9F91), 621 (prm 0x9821): MODE bank, u8, ROM and full-reset default 0; 1 = the variant meters at the AF target. data/specs/spot-menu.json gives them the rows of the page Spot Metering

ops._note: new code, 212 B of 292 (exp debug printers, segment 1)
